title: Baby Pink Embroidered Cotton Kurta Pant Set with Bird Motif & Tassels
color_custom: Baby pink with red, coral & green bird embroidery
description:
A little garden you can wear. This baby-pink cotton kurta set blooms with a folk-inspired embroidered yoke – a pair of red birds among vines, flowers and leaves – finished with playful multicolour tassels. Soft, joyful and made for long happy days.

✦ The Details
• Round neck with tie-up keyhole and tassels
• Bird and floral thread embroidery on the yoke
• Gathered A-line flare below the yoke
• 3/4 balloon sleeves with embroidered cuffs
• Matching straight cotton pants
• 2-piece set: kurta and pants

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, breathable and comfortable all day. The embroidery uses red, coral, green and navy threads for a rich, hand-crafted look.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Silver jhumkas and pearl heels for a festive lunch; white sneakers for a casual day out; add a white chikankari dupatta for puja or a family function.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: A-line Kurta (cotton, embroidered yoke with tassels)
care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash, then gentle hand wash in cold water. Do not wring or bleach. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse side, avoiding the embroidery.
